name: execute_command
description: Run a shell command. Destructive, network, and privilege-escalation commands are blocked. Truncated output reports shown/total counts; narrow or page instead of rerunning variants. Failures report the exit code.

command.description: Shell command. Background long-running servers and redirect their output before probing them; never run one in the foreground. Do not pipe interactive commands through `head`, `tail`, `grep`, or `tee`; they can wait for process exit and stall.

pty.description: Required. Use true for interactive CLIs (prompts, QR codes, full-screen UI), false otherwise. Keyboard input is not forwarded. Blocking interactive commands are stopped after about 10-20 seconds of silence and return partial output; prefer non-blocking or headless flags.
